principles: Use KOALA.md as the host-neutral workflow source and keep host files as adapter wrappers.
Make profile selection and asset emission a typed CLI policy, not scattered conditionals or prompt wording.
Preserve existing user-owned docs unless Koala markers make the managed section explicit.
Keep the old all-assets default temporarily for compatibility while making explicit profile use obvious.
drivers: Avoid Claude/Codex asset drift in external projects.
Keep Codex adapter verification meaningful without failing profiles that intentionally skip Codex assets.
Protect current users who rely on default koala init creating both surfaces.

options.name: A: profile matrix with canonical KOALA.md
pros: Creates one neutral source for workflow facts.
Can be verified with deterministic contract tests.
cons: Requires touching init, templates, and existing entrypoint tests together.

options.name: B: prompt/docs-only guidance
cons: Does not prevent wrong assets from being generated.
Allows AGENTS/CLAUDE/Codex docs to drift again.

options.name: C: change default to auto-detected single host immediately
pros: Cleanest first-run UX for new projects.
Removes most irrelevant files by default.
cons: Breaks existing users who expect both adapter surfaces from plain koala init.
Environment detection is not reliable enough to be the only source of truth.

chosen: A: profile matrix with canonical KOALA.md
rationale: Option A is the only path that turns host asset generation into a machine-verifiable contract while preserving current default behavior for existing projects.

preMortem.scenario: Default init unexpectedly stops generating one host surface for existing users.
preMortem.trigger: Plain koala init is changed to codex or claude instead of all.
preMortem.consequence: Existing workflows or tests that expect both AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md lose an adapter.
preMortem.mitigation: Keep no-profile default as all for this story and print a compatibility fallback reason.

preMortem.scenario: Codex verification fails on claude/core profile.
preMortem.trigger: --verify-codex always calls runCodexAdapterChecks even when .Codex assets are intentionally absent.
preMortem.consequence: A correct Claude-only or core init looks broken.
preMortem.mitigation: Gate Codex verification to codex/all profiles; explicit --verify-codex on claude/core prints a clear skip message.

preMortem.trigger: init writes AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, or KOALA.md without checking koala markers.
preMortem.consequence: Project-specific agent instructions are lost or polluted.
preMortem.mitigation: Use managed-section sync only when markers exist; otherwise skip existing docs.
